newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle same store sales flat.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle same store sales flat.

text.p: American Eagle Outfitters Inc Thursday reported sales for the four and 43 week periods ended November 30.
Sales in millions of dollars Percent change

The company pointed out the shift in the Thanksgiving holiday, which included nine holiday shopping days in the 1995 calendar period ending December 2, 1995, versus two holiday shopping days in the 1996 calendar period ending November 30, 1996, had a negative impact on comparable store sales comparisons.

On a calendar basis, it said, same store sales decreased 13.0 percent compared with the corresponding four week calendar period and increased 2.7 percent for the 43 week calendar period ending December 2, 1995.

The company further noted that last year's sales were very promotional as it attempted to reduce excess inventory. This year's November sales results were achieved with approximately 25 percent less inventory than last year, which should result in improved merchandise margins, it said.
